selection.basis: Q00007/C109 consumed A00079 and A00082 as PASS. These remaining odd assets have accepted exact Release payload/preflight evidence and no newer A producer result.

material_advance.description: Turns the remaining C109-accepted odd pre-generation evidence into executable source-effect-mask/CLEAN_PLATE units without repeating heavy immutable source QA or fabricating final Korean geometry.

derive: exact effect-inclusive source text bbox including fill, outline, shadow, glow and alpha fringe
exact source glyph/effect removal mask with zero protected non-text pixels
raw-to-readable transform and orientation
baseline vector and signed slant measurements
protected non-text mask
CLEAN_PLATE reconstructed only inside the measured removal mask
source_mask_work_order.unblock_condition: All required outputs exist, CLEAN_PLATE independently passes, and computed candidate_safe_bbox is non-empty.
source_mask_work_order.note: The accepted conservative upper bound is not a glyph mask. Removal may touch only measured NEXT ROUND source/effect pixels.
